class.name: PlanarMirror3D
class.brief_description: A planar mirror on the glass it is the child of.
class.description: The parent [MeshInstance3D] reflects on the side away from its own parent mesh, the mirror's housing (on the side it is seen from without one). A camera mirrored across it renders the scene into a texture drawn over the glass as its [member GeometryInstance3D.material_overlay]. It renders only while the glass is visible, in view and within [member max_distance] of the camera, and cheaply: at [member resolution_scale] of the pixels the glass covers on the screen, without omni/spot shadows, anti-aliasing, GI and screen-space effects, with coarser LODs. The scene's environment is copied each time the mirror starts rendering.

members.member: How far from the camera the mirror still renders, in meters.
The size of the reflection relative to the pixels the glass covers on the screen.
